bias.reason: Thursday's main pivot is 7373, the reclaim line; 7348–52 stays as the secondary pivot below it. Wednesday opened 7371 after an overnight high of 7434.75, topped 7388.75, then sold to 7305.25 — a second sweep of Tuesday's 7308–09 low — and recovered again through the 7320–23 / Nov 5 7323 zone. ES closed 7340.25 at 3:59 PM ET (SPX 7323.64, −0.23%; SPY 730.20, −0.31%, first close under the 200-day average; QQQ 659.51, +0.39%; VIX 24.63). After hours ES traded 7332–7398, last 7393.75 at 4:52 PM PT, above 7372–73 and above Wednesday's 7388.75 high. The structure is still bearish unless 7373 holds as the reclaim. Holding 7373 targets 7390, then 7414 (VIX filter 22.76 for the 7414 upside case). Losing 7373 targets 7348–52. Losing 7348–52 targets 7320–23, 7305, then 7245 (VIX filter 26.36 for the 7245 downside case). Two sweeps of 7305–09 both recovered, so 7320–23 remains the line into Friday's OpEx. Every expiry is negative gamma; SPY and SPX both sit on their weekly floors (730 / 7300). The unpadded plan band is 7305.25–7398 (Wednesday regular session 7305.25–7388.75 union the after-hours range 7332–7398). Padded by 0.25 × Thursday's implied move (SPX ±1.09%, about 80 points) to about 7285–7418. 7414 sits just inside the padded band; 7245 is below it. ES ≈ SPX + 19.5 from Wednesday's regular-session median. Jobless claims and Philly Fed are at 5:30 AM PT; Fed Jefferson 6:25 AM PT; Fed Goolsbee and the Anthropic debut around 9:30 AM PT — no new size into the IPO open; 10-year bond sale at 10:00 AM PT.
